profile_basis.decision: reduce tokens or backbone cost before more JNI or layout work

arms.purpose: measure the quality loss caused by token reduction alone before designing distillation
arms.promotion_ceiling: diagnostic control only; cannot be selected as a fresh Confirmation arm

arms.purpose: test whether distillation recovers A1 quality loss without reopening P1 thresholds

arms.rule: one fixed structural change per arm; no token-count search on P1

arms.reason: profile does not justify blind full-graph INT8 and P1 false-clear sensitivity is unresolved

execution_order: materialize candidate depth cache without sensor truth access
run the P1 engineering and absolute task gates once
stop failed candidates before Android conversion and deep profiling
for P1 engineering pass only, run fixed-APK same-device QNN and full-chain P95
retain only if full-chain P95 speedup is at least 1.15x

teacher_roles: scale anchor only when independently metric-bound
multi_rate_target.fail_closed_rule: stale teacher, invalid scale, excessive disagreement, or student uncertainty produces UNKNOWN; teacher output alone is not an independent metric scale anchor

forbidden: search multiple resolutions, mixed-precision layer sets, token counts, checkpoints, seeds, or cadences on the P1 cohort
profile a quality-failed arm and use speed to rescue it
call DA V2 teacher metric scale independent when it shares the same RGB failure mode
interpret host CUDA cache latency as Android QNN or App FPS
